about: 2026-11-11, the user: a Rumble run-in plays the entering wrestler's own theme, on purpose. The folder wrestler (0x0322, with a theme.bin: run it with WCW_WRESTLERS_DIR=scratch\qa_overnight\w\old) comes in first; five more come in at random. Before the fix (roster.c match_entry) a later entrant could ask for the first entrant's song (sound 0xF1, the folder theme): func_8000A690 was called without the costume. Read the sounds asked for from state.rdram.bin (0x807F33AC count, 0x807F33B0 the last 8): only the first is 0xF1

expect.name: the entrances ran
expect.check: mode == 0 and screen == 42 and entrance_step >= 1 and entrance_step <= 29

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30
